name: Items To Be Requested
query:
SELECT
    b.item_code AS "Item:Link/Item:120",
    b.warehouse AS "Warehouse:Link/Warehouse:120",
    b.actual_qty AS "Actual:Float:90",
    b.indented_qty AS "Requested:Float:90",
    b.reserved_qty AS "Reserved:Float:90",
    b.ordered_qty AS "Ordered:Float:90",
    b.projected_qty AS "Projected:Float:90"
FROM
    `tabBin` b
INNER JOIN `tabItem` i
    ON b.item_code = i.name
WHERE
    b.projected_qty < 0
ORDER BY
    b.projected_qty ASC;
